'''2018 MPC Tim Culver LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tim Culver]] at [[2018 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tim Culver]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open We Have A Plan Culver LS 2018 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-match-play-championships/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013163128/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2018-match-play-championships.html Internet Archive]
